verdict.rationale: The CLI supports listing skill contents before installing (--list flag) and installed skills are written as real files/symlinks into project or global directories that can be inspected afterward (skills list/ls, symlink strategy). However there's no dedicated diff/preview-content command, no documented per-file content preview before add, and no explicit safety-review tooling (e.g., permission prompts, content diffing) mentioned anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit pre-install file/content preview beyond --list, a documented way to inspect script contents before execution, and any safety-review or diff tooling.
